{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "fanquake",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "noted base PR has been merged"
    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested moving socket reset out of CheckGlobals as a style nit"
    },
    {
      "login": "brunoerg",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but noted that invariant checks are skipped when sockets are closed by the handler"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4493101124",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "avoid using CheckGlobals for socket cleanup and instead reset in affected fuzz targets or enforce via a linter",
      "quote": "design-wise this struct was more meant to be a no-op linter (only crash on a bug), not a behavior-changing cleanup utility",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author moved ResetFuzzedSockets to affected targets with a sanity check",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4494602666",
        "rc:4495233665",
        "rc:4495792311"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4495792311",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, along with a sanity check akin to that used for the global PRNG / mocked time states."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4519376031",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Skipping readiness, m_recv_twice, and m_send_after_short checks when a socket is closed causes the fuzz target to miss invariant violations because handler bugs typically trigger socket closure",
      "quote": "The problem is that the bugs these checks look for usually end with the handler closing the socket.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the approach to retain test nodes and assert invariants even when connection was closed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4636470616"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4636470616",
      "status_by_quote": "I updated the approach to keep a vector of the test nodes, along with a copy of the socket shared_ptr and whether that peer was paused. The second loop now iterates through that vector and asserts invariants for all of them, including when the connection was closed."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6754653195",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author updated the PR to assert invariants for all nodes including closed sockets, addressing brunoerg's objection.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "brunoerg to re-review after the author updated the approach to assert invariants on closed connections",
      "id": "rc:4636470616"
    }
  ]
}
